mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.title, p.cover, p.price, p.original_price, p.`condition`, p.city, p.status, u.nick_name sellerNickName, u.avatar sellerAvatar, f.fav_time FROM product_favorite f JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY f.fav_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_favorite (user_id, product_id, original_price, fav_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{originalPrice}, NOW() , #{tenantId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET want_count = want_count + 1 WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.user_id AS userId, f.product_id AS productId, f.original_price AS snapPrice, p.price AS newPrice, p.title, p.tenant_id AS tenantId FROM product_favorite f JOIN product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE p.status = 'onsale' AND f.original_price IS NOT NULL AND p.price < f.original_price AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_favorite f JOIN product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id SET f.original_price = p.price WHERE f.original_price IS NULL AND p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE product_favorite SET original_price = #{price} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY user_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET want_count = GREATEST(want_count - 1, 0) WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY user_id ASC
